angular:listbox: Renders <div> by default; the template's first branch is the as="ul" one the pickers use, which a static read takes for the root.
blazor:listbox: A fixed <ul role="listbox">, documented in Listbox.razor: every consumer is a *-picker, which needs <ul>; Razor has no clean dynamic element.
nunjucks:listbox: A fixed <ul role="listbox"> (its macro header says so), for the pickers' <ul class="{helper}-list">; the macro takes no element choice.
